title: Make POG Worker Contract real and wired

contract.name: POG Worker Contract
contract.purpose: Autonomous portfolio operations backbone, governance contract, and machine work queue

runtime_schema_required.ops.worker_registry: registered workers, lambda binding, lane, status, heartbeat, last_run_at
runtime_schema_required.ops.work_queue: priority jobs with idempotency_key, owner, lane, payload, status, receipts
runtime_schema_required.ops.ingestion_jobs: source scans for route53, vercel, github, supabase, stripe, llm_export, browser_export
runtime_schema_required.ops.canonical_entities: canonical tracked objects with type, lifecycle_state, evidence_level, source, current_ref
runtime_schema_required.audit.evidence_register: receipts, runtime logs, health checks, deploy results, source refs

work_queue.description: Normalise 60-row provisional domain lock workbook; DNS probe 35 domains; set evidence_level=REAL only where externally verified
Bind evidence_register.source_table and source_ref to canonical_entities

Wire source ingestion jobs and dispatch workers
Deploy daily sweep worker and schedule pog-daily-sweep
Wire telemetry, QA, heartbeat and failure alerts
Map research/IP lineage to canonical entities and evidence
Generate autonomous remediation recommendations from drift and missing evidence

governance.change_feed: ACTIVE: every canonical_entity mutation emits event

acceptance_checks: All four workers are registered and heartbeat-capable

Seven ingestion jobs inserted and dispatchable
prod_guard blocks prod without REAL evidence
receipt written to receipts/runtime and audit.evidence_register
